e.title: Snorkel Multi-Turn Underwriting
e.summary: 商业险核保多轮对话数据集（Snorkel AI 官方，36 likes，Apache-2.0）：agent 核保任务+参考答案+正确性标注
e.summary_en: Multi-turn insurance underwriting dataset (Snorkel AI official, 36 likes, Apache-2.0): agent underwriting tasks with reference answers and correctness labels
e.summary_hk: 商業險核保多輪對話數據集（Snorkel AI 官方，36 likes，Apache-2.0）：agent 核保任務+參考答案+正確性標註
e.body: Multi-Turn-Insurance-Underwriting（Snorkel AI 官方，500 下载/36 likes，Apache-2.0）是商业险核保的多轮对话数据集：agent 核保任务（公司任务/多轮 trace/参考答案/正确性标注/公司特征——年收入/员工数/车辆数/建筑类型/州/LOB）——保险 agent 的评估与微调数据。对 RIAA：保险 agent 的评测数据——[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]（保险 AI 可靠性基准）的对话版；Snorkel（数据标注权威）官方出品；商业险核保（commercial underwriting）场景（[[insurance-support-agent]] 配套）；参考答案+正确性标注支持 agent 评估（[[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]] 开发配套）；适合保险 agent 评估与核保自动化。
e.body_en: Multi-Turn-Insurance-Underwriting (Snorkel AI official, 500 downloads/36 likes, Apache-2.0) is a multi-turn dialogue dataset for commercial insurance underwriting: agent underwriting tasks (company task/multi-turn trace/reference answer/correctness label/company features — annual revenue/employees/vehicles/construction/state/LOB) — evaluation and fine-tuning data for insurance agents. For RIAA: evaluation data for insurance agents — the dialogue version of [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] (insurance AI reliability); official from Snorkel (data-labelling authority); commercial underwriting scenarios (pairs with [[insurance-support-agent]]); reference answers + correctness labels support agent evaluation (complements [[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]] development); suits insurance agent evaluation and underwriting automation.
e.body_hk: Multi-Turn-Insurance-Underwriting（Snorkel AI 官方，500 下載/36 likes，Apache-2.0）是商業險核保的多輪對話數據集：agent 核保任務（公司任務/多輪 trace/參考答案/正確性標註/公司特徵——年收入/員工數/車輛數/建築類型/州/LOB）——保險 agent 的評估與微調數據。對 RIAA：保險 agent 的評測數據——[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]（保險 AI 可靠性基準）的對話版；Snorkel（數據標註權威）官方出品；商業險核保（commercial underwriting）場景（[[insurance-support-agent]] 配套）；參考答案+正確性標註支持 agent 評估（[[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]] 開發配套）；適合保險 agent 評估與核保自動化。
e.verified_note: HF API 核实（2026-08-30）：500 下载 / 36 赞，Snorkel AI 出品，商业核保师多轮对话轨迹+元数据，核保 AI 训练/评测数据集
